DML.SELECT: SELECT i.id as "id", i.incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", i.location_id as "locationId", i.user_id as "userId", i.road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", i.delayed_incident_state_type_id as "delayedIncidentStateTypeId", i.affection_stretch_id as "affectionStretchId", i.cron_expression as "cronExpression", i.auto_close_in_min as "autoCloseInMin", i.enabled as "enabled", i.visible as "visible", i.created_at as "createdAt", i.last_update as "lastUpdate" FROM rt.ims_delayed_incident_reports i WHERE i.enabled = true or i.enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_delayed_incident_reports (id, incident_type_id, location_id, user_id, road_impact_id, affection_stretch_id, cron_expression, auto_close_in_min, enabled, visible, created_at, last_update) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_delayed_incident_report_id'}, :incidentTypeId, :locationId, :userId, :roadImpactId, :affectionStretchId, :cronExpression, :autoCloseInMin, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_delayed_incident_reports SET cron_expression = :cronExpression, auto_close_in_min = :autoCloseInMin, delayed_incident_state_type_id = :delayedIncidentStateTypeId, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = :id
